sourceProvenance.geometryOrigin: New parametric standalone topology; provenance states no source mesh, ready base, or candidate geometry/reference was used or reused.

garmentTypeAndCoverage.observation: All four captures read as a standalone long-sleeve shirt with front placket/buttons, cuffs, and a shirt collar. No mannequin or body is present.

shoulderAndArmholeTopology.observation: The new shoulder yokes bridge the front/back body edges and the sleeve-root closures meet the swept sleeves. Front, back, side, and oblique views show continuous shoulders and armholes without the open dark gaps seen in v1-v3; the small edge shadows read as seams, not openings.

collarAndNeckline.observation: The neckline facing and collar stand now sit on the neckline, with both collar leaves attached at the front boundary. The four views read as a joined pointed office-shirt collar; no detached cylindrical ring or open neck seam is visible.

silhouetteVolumeAndFolds.observation: Regular-fit torso and swept sleeves retain visible volume; restrained torso drape from the previously approved correction remains visible. The new topology does not flatten the garment.

buttonsAndCuffs.observation: The front placket and button row remain legible, and both long sleeves end in cuffs with visible cuff buttons.

summary: QA độc lập duyệt phom xám ATEL-47/v4. Cả 11 hash khớp manifest; provenance xác nhận topology standalone mới, không dùng mesh nguồn; browser preview desktop load/rotate/zoom đạt, không lỗi. Vai/armhole và cổ/neckline liền topology trong bốn góc; folds được giữ pass, áo vẫn có volume, tay dài, khuy trước/cổ tay và không mannequin. Cho phép chuyển Material; màu/artwork, content, viewer và QA cuối vẫn chưa duyệt.
